results.en:
The Radion is the perfect turf defender.
With powerful projectile attacks and a heavily armored body, Radions can be critical in providing support for the team.

[impulse] to fire the Shard Attack.
[fire] to fire the Bomb Lob.
[age] or [reload] to Melee.
